declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty content scope. The factory workflow declaration governs work throughout this factory-profile repository, including tracker work that changes no files. .factory/config.json stays owned by its separate exact declaration.

Intentionally empty: remote fixes reconcile GitHub settings and read-only checks validate repository-owned review data without writing it. Git origin names only lutzseverino/scriptorium; authenticated gh reports PUBLIC and main, with no repository-level variables. REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON is unset, using the hosted default; this user-owned repository has no organization inheritance. The owner requested this update on 2026-10-29, authorizing its remote setup.

Intentionally empty: the repository holds one package, `@lutzseverino/scriptorium`, whose only manifest is the root package.json, with src/ and test/ at the root and no workspace or build configuration naming another component. The package is the repository itself, so its README is the root README.md, which the repository-readme declaration owns; there is no non-root Project and so no non-root README to propose. The README.md files under docs/ are documentation indexes owned by the documentation scope.

The sole root package @lutzseverino/scriptorium is the repository Project: package.json names start, typecheck and tests over src/ and test/, and there are no workspace members. Toolchain PR #56 is merged. The manifest and pnpm-lock.yaml match pnpm 11, Node 24/26, oxlint 1, Prettier 3 and validate. TypeScript 7.0.2, node --test, required CI Test aggregating both Node jobs running pnpm validate, and docs/development/README.md Setup and validation establish the contextual stack rules. Copied source inputs and fixture packages are not Projects.
